vulnerability.impact: VelocityResponseWriter template injection leading to remote code execution

entry_points: SolrParamResourceLoader.getResourceReader - serves templates from request parameters (params resource loader) when params.resource.loader.enabled is set
VelocityResponseWriter (config wt=velocity / v.template params) - renders attacker-supplied Velocity template code
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in Apache Solr 8.4.0 (8.x line) and 7.7.2 (7.x line). Official 8.x commit: 128360856d50d7b39473644e6c1c21ba11766195 (SOLR-14025: VelocityResponseWriter hardening; removes SolrParamResourceLoader and only renders configset templates from trusted configsets). 7.7.x backport commits for the original vector: cbd17d1e83279c613e5e936c69993dc6ce70bc26 (SOLR-13971 patch for 7.7) and 5dad789154fbdc77c0a16d0febca7d63985325de (Committing the fix for SOLR-14025). Pinned snapshot releases/lucene-solr/8.3.0 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.affected_range: Apache Solr 5.0.0 through 8.3.1 (fixed 8.4.0; 7.x fixed in 7.7.2); snapshot is 8.3.0.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies the Velocity params resource loader (SolrParamResourceLoader / VelocityResponseWriter with params.resource.loader.enabled=true or v.template with a velocity/ configset template) as the code-execution sink, names CVE-2019-17558, and attributes unauthenticated (or low-privilege when auth enabled) remote code execution. Findings limited to other Solr RCEs (e.g. CVE-2019-0193) are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: snapshot contains SolrParamResourceLoader and a VelocityResponseWriter that renders request-parameter templates; 8.4.0 removes SolrParamResourceLoader. Dynamic reproduction: run snapshot Solr in a disposable container with a temp core and issue a wt=velocity request with a harmless template expression (arithmetic or marker output); no file writes/network payloads.
